svg.title: RoomSense data and training pipeline (DVC DAG)
svg.text: DVC DAG: one stage reruns only when its inputs or params changed
scripts/run_pipeline.py runs dvc repro and records the run: status, seconds and throughput of every stage
Reproduce any experiment: git checkout <commit> → dvc pull → dvc repro (the MLflow run stores the commit and the data version)
